items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Joe was mostly local stuff. He never went anywhere in the way of speaking, you know?

ctx.x: What about, say, Wooden Joe as compared with Wooden?
Well, that's the difference altogether. He never made to hear what these men made, you know? Joe was mostly local stuff. He never went anywhere in the way of speaking, you know?
I just wondered if he played as loud as Bowden Joe.
